row_grain: one canonical scholarly work, not one venue occurrence
csv_encoding: UTF-8 RFC4180; JSON cells serialized compactly and quoted by a CSV library

null_policy.missing_abstract: empty string plus abstract_status=missing; never literal fabricated summary

fields.name: paper_id
fields.description_zh: 跨版本/来源的规范 work ID；优先可靠标识符映射，不仅靠题名强行合并。

fields.name: title
fields.description_zh: 规范题名，保留来源版本与选择依据。

fields.name: abstract
fields.description_zh: 真实已抓取摘要；缺失留空，不能用生成摘要冒充。

fields.name: authors_json
fields.description_zh: 原始作者名；未知 null，确认为无则 []。

fields.name: doi
fields.description_zh: 核验 DOI；未知留空。

fields.name: arxiv_id
fields.description_zh: 核验 arXiv ID，不从汇总计数推断关联。

fields.name: openreview_id
fields.description_zh: 核验 OpenReview ID。

fields.name: official_url
fields.description_zh: 论文官方公开页面。

fields.name: source_urls_json
fields.description_zh: 所有实际用于此行元数据/分类的来源。

fields.name: publication_year
fields.description_zh: 选定的出版/接收年份；无可靠值留空。venue/year 统计从 occurrences 展开，不能用此列代替全部出现年份。

fields.name: year_basis
fields.description_zh: 年份来自会议目录、文章元数据或其他依据；不虚构月份。

fields.name: venues_json
fields.description_zh: 所有已确认收录会议。

fields.name: occurrence_ids_json
fields.description_zh: 指向 occurrence 表，保留每次 venue/year/track 出现。

fields.name: occurrences_json
fields.description_zh: 可供单 CSV Explorer 使用的 occurrence 信息：occurrence_id、venue、year、track、source_id、source_url、coverage_status。

fields.name: dedup_status
fields.description_zh: single_source / identifier_matched / title_author_reviewed / unresolved；不把题名近似当同一 work。

fields.name: dedup_evidence_json
fields.description_zh: 跨来源合并依据及冲突。

fields.name: field_provenance_json
fields.description_zh: 逐字段来源 source_url、source_record_id、retrieved_at、status、transform；abstract 来源独立于 title。

fields.name: abstract_status
fields.description_zh: present / missing / truncated / unverified；词数/字数不是内容真实性保证。

fields.name: abstract_char_count
fields.description_zh: 所存摘要实际字符数。

fields.name: coverage_flags_json
fields.description_zh: year_partial、abstract_missing、track_scope_break、title_only、source_conflict 等真实覆盖问题。

fields.name: classification_status
fields.description_zh: classified / outside_scope / insufficient_evidence / taxonomy_gap；不是第六层。

fields.name: classification_label_status
fields.description_zh: candidate / accepted / disputed / unassigned；初轮自动标注为 candidate。

fields.name: classification_method
fields.description_zh: 如 rules_candidate_v1 / llm_title_abstract_v1 / human_review；必须如实。

fields.name: classifier_version
fields.description_zh: 规则/模型提示/配置的可复现版本。

fields.name: taxonomy_version
fields.description_zh: 精确 taxonomy 版本。

fields.name: classified_at
fields.description_zh: 实际运行时间 UTC ISO8601。

fields.name: classification_basis
fields.description_zh: title_only / title_abstract / title_abstract_fulltext / metadata_only；metadata_only 不能以 venue 判断 leaf。

fields.name: classification_input_fields_json
fields.description_zh: 实际输入字段及其 sha256，可复现。

fields.name: classification_reason
fields.description_zh: 简短判定/不判定理由，不输出私有推理。

fields.name: review_status
fields.description_zh: unreviewed / automated / ai_adjudicated / human_reviewed / disputed。

fields.name: review_notes
fields.description_zh: 简短冲突/待补证说明；自动首轮不写人工已核验。

fields.name: category_ids_l1_json
fields.description_zh: 由有证据 L3 路径去重得到的 L1。

fields.name: category_ids_l2_json
fields.description_zh: 由有证据 L3 路径去重得到的 L2。

fields.name: category_ids_l3_json
fields.description_zh: 被分配的 L3，自动时属于候选。

fields.name: category_paths_json
fields.description_zh: 每个叶子的 [L1_ID,L2_ID,L3_ID]，一个论文可以有多个。

fields.name: category_paths_text
fields.description_zh: 方便阅读的 id/name 路径；真源仍是 JSON。

fields.name: category_evidence_json
fields.description_zh: 每个叶子至少一条证据：category_id、source_field、source_url、span_start/end、quote、assignment_role、rationale、evidence_strength、basis、rule_ids、review_status。

fields.name: facets_json
fields.description_zh: method/task/stage/evaluation/safety/contribution_type/domain/model_modality/model_scope/agent_form；unknown 与 [] 分开。

fields.name: facet_evidence_json
fields.description_zh: facet 名、值、来源字段、跨度、引用、理由。不能靠分类叶子随意推断。

fields.name: candidate_topics_json
fields.description_zh: taxonomy_gap 或待补证的候选主题；不参与五层计数。

fields.name: label_warnings_json
fields.description_zh: title_only、ambiguous_acronym、weak_rule_match、needs_fulltext 等。

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description_zh: 主来源真实采集时间；其他来源时间放逐字段 provenance。

fields.name: record_updated_at
fields.description_zh: 此主表行本次更新的实际时间。

fields.name: authors_raw
fields.description_zh: 保留无法可靠结构化的作者/机构原文，例如 OSDI 混合逗号字符串；不把空结构列表说成无作者。

fields.name: author_affiliations_json
fields.description_zh: 按 occurrence_id 与 author_position 保留有序作者—多机构链接；复制审计 authors[*].affiliations，保留 name、时间状态、原文和出处。不同版本作者顺序不得混写。

fields.name: institutions_json
fields.description_zh: 来源报告的机构原文字串去重并集；可能含 profile/历史时间未验证机构。不是规范实体库，也不默认代表发表期机构。

fields.name: publication_affiliations_json
fields.description_zh: 仅具有论文/发表版本明确机构证据的结构化机构记录；保留 occurrence/author 关联。论文列机构但作者未链接时必须注明 unlinked，不擅自归给全部作者。

fields.name: profile_affiliations_json
fields.description_zh: API user/profile 或程序资料中的机构，发表期有效性未验证；保留可展示，不参与历史机构/国家分布。

fields.name: unlinked_affiliations_json
fields.description_zh: 来源明确报告但无法关联具体作者的机构列表；保留来源与时间状态，不能向相邻姓名传播。

fields.name: institution_entities_json
fields.description_zh: 只有已核验的机构规范实体及 ID：scheme、id、name、resolution_status、source_url/locator；没有核验时保留 unresolved 原文或空 ID，禁止臆造 ROR/OpenAlex 等。

fields.name: countries_json
fields.description_zh: 论文发表期 affiliation 的明确国家/地区代码去重列表；兼容 audit.countries；绝非作者国籍。无证据 []/null 配合状态，不推断。

fields.name: country_evidence_json
fields.description_zh: 每个国家/地区到 occurrence、作者槽位、机构原文和明确地点词的证据关系；保留 code/name/code_scheme、temporal_status、source_url/locator、country_status、missing_reason。

fields.name: author_affiliation_completeness
fields.description_zh: complete / partial / missing / unstructured / not_checked；complete 仅指已读来源中的作者链接覆盖，发表期覆盖另列。

fields.name: affiliation_temporal_status
fields.description_zh: paper_scoped / profile_time_unverified / mixed / paper_reported_unlinked / missing / not_checked；行级概览不能抹去各条机构时间状态。

fields.name: institution_resolution_status
fields.description_zh: verified_all / verified_partial / unresolved / not_checked / missing；机构字符串有值不等于已规范化/ID 核验。

fields.name: country_coverage_status
fields.description_zh: complete_known_author_affiliations / partial / missing / not_checked / conflict；至少一位有国家仍常常只是 partial。

fields.name: metadata_field_status_json
fields.description_zh: 逐字段保留 audit.field_provenance 的原 status；至少 authors/affiliations/institutions/countries/institution_ids，并记录当前映射状态。

fields.name: metadata_missing_reasons_json
fields.description_zh: 逐字段和必要的作者/机构槽位缺失原因，如 no_explicit_publication_time_affiliation_country、institution_profile_is_not_historical_location_evidence、unstructured_author_string。

fields.name: metadata_field_coverage_json
fields.description_zh: 本行作者槽位分母、已结构化数、有机构数、论文期机构数、有明确国家数、规范 ID 核验数；unknown 与 0 分开，保留部分覆盖。

fields.name: metadata_occurrence_provenance_json
fields.description_zh: 每个出现版本的来源字段、状态、missing_reason、evidence 原样保留，避免 work 合并覆盖冲突的机构/国家。

fields.name: metadata_audit_version
fields.description_zh: 实际使用 enrichment 脚本/输入 manifest 的版本或 SHA；未运行留空并给 not_checked，不声称已在本机复核原始源。

evidence_contract.span_unit: Python/Unicode code-point offsets, 0-based, [start,end), over the exact stored source_field. JavaScript must use Array.from(text) or equivalent for non-BMP characters.
evidence_contract.rule_baseline: rule_ids identify a separate versioned rule file; spans show literal match, and basis must say lexical_rule_candidate. A hit is not verified semantic evidence.
prohibited_without_validation: claiming fulltext basis with title/abstract only

counting_contract.paper_denominator: distinct paper_id within explicitly selected corpus/years/coverage statuses
counting_contract.occurrence_denominator: distinct occurrence_id within selected venue/year/track; reported separately
counting_contract.multilabel: count distinct paper_id per category after closure; sum can exceed total
counting_contract.arxiv_warning: Aggregate arXiv counts are not paper-level master rows; do not fabricate records or cross-corpus coverage.
counting_contract.unresolved_work_label: If unresolved duplicate candidates remain, label total as provisional work IDs; do not claim proven unique papers.
counting_contract.institution_country_counting: A multi-institution/multi-country paper counts once per supported institution/country; sums may exceed paper total. Do not assign fractional contributions without an explicitly documented rule.

migration: Additive columns and nested contracts only; existing columns remain. Populate unknowns with documented empty/null + status/missing reason. No taxonomy changes.

metadata_audit_alignment.join_warning: Join exact occurrence composite key; never title-only, and source_paper_id alone is not globally unique. Preserve occurrence_id before work aggregation.

maps.authors_json: ordered audit.authors[*].name; preserve previous name array convention
maps.author_affiliations_json: audit.authors, augmented with occurrence_id, 1-based author_position and source evidence references
maps.institutions_json: audit.institutions, labeled source-reported and not normalized
maps.countries_json: audit.countries, only explicit publication-affiliation country/region codes
maps.metadata_occurrence_provenance_json: one unmodified provenance object per source occurrence

author_affiliation_object.author_position: 1-based order within this source byline; null if unknown; never unique person count
author_affiliation_object.author_name: source name; no cross-paper identity inference
author_affiliation_object.author_ids: verified ORCID/source IDs only; unknown empty

affiliations.name: unmodified source institution string
affiliations.affiliation_key: source-scoped local ID; not an institutional registry ID
affiliations.temporal_status: preserve original audit value; paper_scoped_explicit / paper_explicit / publication_time_unverified / paper_reported_unlinked / unknown

institution_ids.scheme: e.g. ROR or another verified registry
institution_ids.resolution_status: verified_exact or verified_manual; unresolved is not a verified entity

affiliations.country_code: explicit affiliation location code, else empty
affiliations.country_missing_reason: required if code absent after checking
affiliations.evidence_refs: point to existing audit field provenance plus local author/affiliation ordinal

temporal_normalization.publication_time_unverified: profile/program report retained but excluded from publication-time geography
temporal_normalization.paper_reported_unlinked: paper-level institution known but author linkage unknown; no invented author mapping

affiliation_country_contract.country_definition_zh: 国家/地区表示该论文/版本作者机构的地点，绝不表示作者国籍、族裔、出生地、居住地或个人身份。保留来源报告的国家/地区代码；不赋予政治含义。
affiliation_country_contract.country_acceptance_zh: 首轮沿用审计的明确论文期 affiliation 地点词。以后如另行核验同一论文期机构/校区地址，必须新增来源和 separately_verified_paper_location 状态；只有规范机构 ID 或今天总部地址仍不足以推断历史地点。
prohibited_inference_sources: institution name containing a country word
affiliation_country_contract.country_example_zh: University of Science and Technology of China 的机构名本身不能推出 CN；MOE Key Laboratory ..., Peking University, China 中独立地址地点 China 可以作为明确国家地点。
affiliation_country_contract.no_false_completeness: An institution present for one author does not mean all affiliations are known. A country present for one affiliation does not mean all authors or affiliations have known countries.
affiliation_country_contract.flat_array_rule: Flat institutions/countries are convenience unions, not substitutes for author-affiliation provenance. Work-level union across versions must remain traceable by occurrence; historical filters select matching occurrence.
affiliation_country_contract.null_policy: null means not checked/unknown; [] means checked and no supported structured value. Never display [] as no author/no institution/no country. Show status and missing reason.

coverage_object.author_slots_total: integer or null; source-byline slots, not unique people
coverage_object.scope: occurrence or work; include occurrence_breakdown for merged work

affiliation_country_contract.geography_display: Default historical institution/country filters use publication-scoped evidence. Offer profile/unverified institutions separately and visibly. Country charts must show records with eligible country / all selected records and author-slot coverage; unknown is not another country.

source_coverage_manifest_contract.grain: one expected source venue/year/track even if zero rows were collected
rules: no_event is structural absence, never zero research output
not_collected/partial must remain visible even with no paper rows
announced_expected_count unknown remains blank, not zero
2026 provisional and scope changes remain separate
coverage manifest is required for Explorer denominators, not inferable solely from collected rows
